description: Level crossings is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Schweizerische Bundesbahnen SBB. Bahnübergänge sind niveau-gleiche Gleisquerungen, die Signaltechnisch gesichert; mit Blinklicht/Schranken oder mit Verkehrsregelungsanlage oder ungesichert sind. Die Daten geben ausschliesslich das SBB AG-Streckennetz wieder. Die Daten unterliegen einer wöchentlichen Aktualisierung und Vervollständigung. Level crossings are track crossings of the same level, which are secured with flashing/barriers or with traffic control systems or unsecured. Coverage: Switzerland. The portal files it under the publisher Schweizerische Bundesbahnen SBB. It offers 15 resource(s) in CSV, GPX, JSON, JSON-LD, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use, the source must be given. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
